title: Query cache enabled
condition: query_cache_type not OFF with a non-zero query_cache_size.

title: Checkpoint age near redo capacity
condition: Checkpoint age >= 75% of its maximum.

title: Per-account workload profile (MariaDB user statistics)
condition: Always emitted when userstat is ON.

title: InnoDB corruption messages in the error log
condition: InnoDB integrity messages in performance_schema.error_log within the lookback window.

title: Replica lag over 5 minutes
condition: Applier lag >= 300 s.

title: Group Replication member not ONLINE
condition: A group member is not ONLINE, or the group has fewer than 3 members.

title: Crash-recovery messages in the error log
condition: Crash or unclean-shutdown messages in performance_schema.error_log.

title: GTID set has gaps
condition: gtid_executed contains more intervals than source UUIDs.

title: Replica lag over 30 seconds
condition: Applier lag >= 30 s and < 300 s.

title: Persisted variables override the configuration files
condition: A persisted variable overrides a file-sourced value.

title: sql_require_primary_key off while primary-key-less tables exist
condition: sql_require_primary_key OFF while primary-key-less tables exist.

title: Persisted variables (inventory)
condition: Always emitted when persisted variables exist.

title: Accounts without password expiry (review)
condition: Accounts inherit an unlimited default_password_lifetime.

title: Binary logging disabled — point-in-time recovery impossible
condition: log_bin = OFF on a self-managed primary.

title: Last successful backup unknown or older than 7 days
condition: No backup tool output found, or newest backup >= 7 days old.

title: Data, binary log or temp volume at or above 90 percent full
condition: A MySQL volume is >= 90% full.

title: InnoDB doublewrite buffer disabled
condition: innodb_doublewrite is OFF or DETECT_ONLY.

title: Server running in innodb_force_recovery mode
condition: innodb_force_recovery > 0.

title: End-of-life server reachable from any network interface
condition: MY-REL-001 fired, the server listens on all interfaces, and wildcard-host accounts exist.
reads: as MY-REL-001, plus @@GLOBAL.bind_address, @@GLOBAL.skip_networking, and the wildcard-host account count

title: Replication stopped with an error
condition: A replication thread is not running and an error is recorded.

title: Accounts with no password
condition: An unlocked, non-external-auth account has an empty credential.

title: Superuser-equivalent account reachable from any host
condition: An account with SUPER or all privileges has a wildcard host pattern.

title: Connections at or above 90 percent of max_connections
condition: Threads_connected or Max_used_connections >= 90% of max_connections.

title: Crash-unsafe replication source
condition: MY-DUR-001 and MY-DUR-002 both true and replicas are connected.

title: AUTO_INCREMENT at or above 90 percent exhausted
condition: AUTO_INCREMENT >= 90% of the column type maximum.

title: Anonymous accounts present
condition: An account with an empty username exists.

title: InnoDB history list length very high
condition: InnoDB history list length >= 1,000,000 undo records.

title: innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit not 1
condition: innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit is 0 or 2.

title: sync_binlog not 1
condition: log_bin ON and sync_binlog <> 1.

title: Transaction waiting on a row lock for over 5 minutes
condition: A transaction has waited >= 300 s for a row lock.

title: Idle transaction holding locks for over an hour
condition: An idle transaction has held row locks >= 1 h.

title: Server restarted within the last 24 hours
condition: Uptime < 86,400 s.

title: Replication threads stopped without an error
condition: A replication thread is not running and no error is recorded.

title: Replica is writable
condition: Replica with read_only OFF or super_read_only OFF.

title: Binary log retention shorter than one day
condition: Effective binary log retention < 86,400 s.

title: Volume at or above 80 percent full
condition: A MySQL volume is >= 80% full.

title: Projected disk-full within 30 days
condition: Projected disk-full within 30 days from snapshot growth.

title: Clients refused because max_connections was reached
condition: Connection_errors_max_connections > 0.

title: Transaction open for over an hour
condition: A transaction has been open >= 1 h.

title: InnoDB buffer pool at the shipped default
condition: innodb_buffer_pool_size <= 128 MB with innodb_dedicated_server OFF.

title: Server version is past end of life
condition: The server's release branch is past its end-of-life date.
reads: @@GLOBAL.version, @dbt_fork, and the embedded release table below

title: InnoDB tables without a primary key on a replicated source
condition: An InnoDB table has no primary key and row-based binary logging is in use.

title: Binary logs never expire
condition: log_bin ON and both retention variables are 0.

title: Restore never tested or RPO/RTO undocumented
condition: Last restore test > 90 days, never, or unknown.

title: Binary logs consuming excessive space
condition: Binary logs occupy >= 100 GB or >= 25% of data size.

title: General query log enabled
condition: general_log = ON.

title: Connections at or above 70 percent of max_connections
condition: Threads_connected or Max_used_connections >= 70% and < 90%.

title: max_connections very high with no thread pool and no evidence of a pooler
condition: max_connections >= 1000, no thread pool, and connections are not concentrated.

title: Server saturated at snapshot time
condition: Threads_running >= 2 per core, or >= 64 when cores are unknown.

title: InnoDB page checksums disabled
condition: innodb_checksum_algorithm = none.
reads: @dbt_v_innodb_checksum_algorithm (bundle: present in MySQL 5.6+ and MariaDB 10.x, but read through the bundle so a fork that drops it yields NULL and this check stays silent instead of erroring)

title: Non-transactional storage engines in use
condition: Any user table uses a non-transactional storage engine.

title: Unused index of 1 GB or more
condition: An index >= 1 GB has zero reads since restart.
reads: sys.schema_unused_indexes, or performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_index_usage directly; mysql.innodb_index_stats (stat_name='size') x @@innodb_page_size for size

title: Redundant or duplicate indexes
condition: An index is a leftmost prefix of, or identical to, another index.
reads: sys.schema_redundant_indexes, or an information_schema.STATISTICS self-join where sys is absent

title: Large table with heavy full table scans
condition: A table >= 1 GB has >= 10 M rows read without an index.
reads: sys.schema_tables_with_full_table_scans (object_schema, object_name, rows_full_scanned), information_schema.TABLES for size

title: Transaction waiting on a row lock for over 30 seconds
condition: A transaction has waited >= 30 s and < 300 s for a row lock.

title: Idle transaction holding locks for over 5 minutes
condition: An idle transaction has held row locks >= 5 min and < 1 h.

title: Sessions waiting for a metadata lock
condition: A session has waited >= 30 s for a table metadata lock.

title: Buffer pool far smaller than the InnoDB working set
condition: Buffer pool < 25% of InnoDB data and < 50% of RAM where RAM is known.

title: Worst-case memory commitment exceeds host RAM
condition: Worst-case memory commitment >= host RAM, or RAM unknown.
reads: @@GLOBAL.innodb_buffer_pool_size, innodb_log_buffer_size, key_buffer_size, max_connections, sort/join/read/read_rnd buffers, binlog_cache_size, thread_stack, tmp_table_size, @dbt_ram_bytes

title: Host is swapping
condition: Swap in use >= 1 GB, or non-zero swap-in/swap-out.

title: GTID not in use in a replicated topology
condition: Replication configured and GTID not in use.

title: Statement-based binary logging
condition: log_bin ON and binlog_format = STATEMENT.

title: Replication errors are being skipped
condition: skip_errors is set, or exec_mode is IDEMPOTENT.

title: Semi-synchronous replication has fallen back to asynchronous
condition: Semi-sync enabled but its status variable reads OFF.

title: Replication filters configured
condition: Any replication filter is configured.
reads: performance_schema.replication_applier_filters / replication_applier_global_filters (MySQL 8.0.1+); @dbt_v_replicate_* bundle variables (MariaDB, and MySQL where the performance_schema tables are unavailable)

title: sql_mode is not strict
condition: Global sql_mode lacks a STRICT mode or a zero-date restriction.
reads: @dbt_global_sql_mode (the GLOBAL value captured in 01_session.sql BEFORE this session changed its own sql_mode)

title: AUTO_INCREMENT at or above 70 percent exhausted
condition: AUTO_INCREMENT >= 70% and < 90% of the column type maximum.

title: Integrity checks disabled globally
condition: foreign_key_checks or unique_checks is OFF at global scope.

title: Shared InnoDB tablespace in use
condition: innodb_file_per_table OFF, or tables remain in the system tablespace.

title: Application connections running as a privileged account
condition: >= 5 concurrent non-local connections from a privileged account.
reads: information_schema.PROCESSLIST joined to the normalised account source

title: InnoDB history list length elevated
condition: InnoDB history list length >= 100,000 and < 1,000,000.

title: Undo tablespaces large
condition: Undo storage >= 10 GB, or >= 2 GB with innodb_undo_log_truncate OFF.
reads: information_schema.FILES (MySQL 8.0, FILE_TYPE='UNDO LOG'); information_schema.INNODB_SYS_TABLESPACES (MariaDB, NAME LIKE 'innodb_undo%'); @@GLOBAL.innodb_undo_tablespaces, @@GLOBAL.innodb_undo_log_truncate

title: Redo log capacity below one hour of writes
condition: Redo capacity holds less than one hour of the observed redo write rate.

title: Binary log checksums off
condition: binlog_checksum = NONE with log_bin ON.

title: Managed-platform backups not verifiable from SQL
condition: A managed platform was fingerprinted.

title: InnoDB temporary tablespace large
condition: The InnoDB temporary tablespace is >= 10 GB.

title: Aborted connections high
condition: Aborted_connects or Aborted_clients >= 1% of Connections.

title: Host approaching the connect-error block threshold
condition: A host has reached 50% of max_connect_errors.

title: Most connections are sleeping
condition: >= 80% of >= 100 connections idle with wait_timeout >= 28,800 s.

title: Replica not crash-safe
condition: Replica with relay_log_recovery OFF, or FILE-based position repositories.

title: Write-heavy table carrying many indexes
condition: A table with >= 10 indexes has taken >= 1 M row writes.

title: Table fragmentation (DATA_FREE) high
condition: DATA_FREE >= 30% of data plus index on a table >= 1 GB.

title: Query running for over 10 minutes
condition: A non-replication query has run >= 600 s.

title: Buffer pool over 80 percent of host RAM
condition: Buffer pool >= 80% of host RAM.

title: Buffer pool read miss rate high
condition: Buffer pool miss rate >= 5% over >= 10 M read requests.

title: Implicit temporary tables spilling to disk
condition: Disk temp table ratio >= 25% and >= 1,000/hour.

title: Oversized per-session buffers
condition: Any per-session buffer >= 8 MB globally.

title: Table open cache too small, or open-file limit at risk
condition: Table cache overflows >= 1/min, Opened_tables >= 10/s, or open files >= 80% of the limit.

title: performance_schema disabled
condition: performance_schema = OFF.

title: Slow query log off, or its threshold at the default
condition: slow_query_log OFF, or long_query_time >= 10 s.

title: One statement digest dominates total latency
condition: One digest holds >= 25% of total statement time with >= 1,000 executions.

title: Join and scan counters high
condition: Select_full_join >= 1% or Select_scan >= 20% of Questions.

title: Server version within six months of end of life
condition: The server's release branch reaches end of life within 180 days.

title: Patch release behind
condition: The server is >= 2 patch releases behind its branch.

title: No evidence of a monitoring agent
condition: No account or session name matches a known monitoring agent.

title: Single-threaded replica applier while lagging
condition: Replica lagging with <= 1 applier worker.

title: Replication heartbeat or connection retry misconfigured
condition: Retry interval >= 600 s, retry count 0, or heartbeat interval 0.

title: binlog_row_image MINIMAL with logical consumers configured
condition: binlog_row_image = MINIMAL with logical consumers declared.

title: InnoDB tables without a primary key
condition: An InnoDB table has no primary key and row-based binary logging is not in use.

title: Leftover online-schema-change artefacts
condition: A shadow table or pt-osc trigger from an interrupted schema change remains.

title: Application accounts allowed from any host
condition: A non-privileged account has a wildcard host pattern.

title: TLS not enforced, or largely unused
condition: require_secure_transport OFF and TLS used by < 50% of connections.

title: LOAD DATA LOCAL enabled
condition: local_infile = ON.

title: FILE privilege unrestricted by secure_file_priv
condition: secure_file_priv empty and at least one account holds FILE.

title: Purge threads at default on a server that is not purging fast enough
condition: MY-UNDO-002 fired and innodb_purge_threads <= 4.

title: Redo log buffer waits
condition: Innodb_log_waits > 0 and >= 1/hour.

title: Thread cache misses
condition: Threads_created >= 1% of Connections over >= 100,000 connections.

title: DNS lookups performed on every connection
condition: skip_name_resolve = OFF.

title: No integrity verification practice
condition: No integrity verification practice reported in the interview.

title: Unused index (smaller, or statistics window too short)
condition: An index >= 50 MB and < 1 GB has zero reads since restart.
reads: sys.schema_unused_indexes, or performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_index_usage directly; mysql.innodb_index_stats (stat_name='size') x @@innodb_page_size for size

title: Single-column index on a very low-cardinality column
condition: A single-column index has cardinality <= 3 on a table >= 100 MB.

title: InnoDB persistent statistics stale
condition: InnoDB statistics >= 30 days old, or innodb_stats_persistent OFF.

title: Wide composite indexes
condition: An index spans >= 6 columns on a table >= 100 MB.
reads: information_schema.STATISTICS (SEQ_IN_INDEX, SUB_PART), information_schema.COLUMNS for the declared widths

title: Deadlocks occurring regularly
condition: >= 1 deadlock/day with >= 7 total.

title: Table-level lock waits
condition: Table lock waits >= 1% of table lock requests.

title: Single buffer pool instance with a large pool
condition: Pool >= 8 GB with innodb_buffer_pool_instances = 1.

title: innodb_flush_method not O_DIRECT on Linux
condition: innodb_flush_method not O_DIRECT on Linux with a pool >= 4 GB.

title: Statement digest instrumentation incomplete
condition: statements_digest consumer disabled, or digests lost > 0.

title: Statements failing or warning frequently
condition: A digest errors on >= 5% of >= 1,000 executions.

title: Sort merge passes high
condition: Sort_merge_passes >= 10/s.

title: Plan-hostile patterns in top statement digests
condition: A top digest matches a plan-hostile text pattern.

title: sys schema missing
condition: The sys schema has no views.

title: Error log verbosity reduced
condition: Error log verbosity is below its default.

title: Very large table not partitioned
condition: A single-partition table is >= 200 GB.

title: Table with more than 1,000 partitions
condition: A table has >= 1,000 partitions.

title: Triggers on high-write tables
condition: A table with >= 1 trigger has taken >= 1 M writes.

title: Character set or collation inconsistent within a schema
condition: A schema contains more than one table collation.

title: Deprecated or weak authentication plugins
condition: An account uses mysql_native_password, mysql_old_password or sha256_password.

title: No password validation policy
condition: No password validation plugin or component is active.

title: Legacy test database or test grants present
condition: The legacy test schema exists.

title: Binary log cache spilling to disk
condition: Binlog cache disk-use ratio >= 1% with >= 10,000 uses.

title: innodb_io_capacity at its rotational-disk default on solid-state storage
condition: io_capacity at defaults with baseline.storage declared as ssd, nvme or cloud.

title: Buffer pool dirty page ratio high
condition: Dirty page ratio >= 75% at snapshot.

title: Non-default global variables
condition: Always emitted; one row per non-default global variable.
reads: MySQL: performance_schema.variables_info joined to global_variables; MariaDB: information_schema.SYSTEM_VARIABLES (GLOBAL_VALUE vs DEFAULT_VALUE)

title: Variables differing from the supplied baseline
condition: A supplied baseline differs from the running configuration.

title: Buffer pool warm-up not configured (review)
condition: Buffer pool dump-at-shutdown or load-at-startup is OFF.

title: server_id left at its default in a replicated topology
condition: server_id is 0 or 1 in a replicated topology.

title: Legacy character sets and row formats (inventory)
condition: Tables use a legacy character set or a pre-Barracuda row format.

title: Listening on all interfaces (review)
condition: bind_address is unrestricted and skip_networking is OFF.

title: No audit logging (review)
condition: No audit plugin or component is active.

title: Privileged accounts (review list)
condition: An account holds any global privilege that escapes its own scope.

title: Top 10 statements by total latency
condition: Always emitted when digests are available.

title: Top 10 statements by average latency
condition: Always emitted when digests are available.

title: Top 10 statements by rows examined per row sent
condition: Rows examined per row sent >= 100 with >= 100 executions.

title: Top 10 statements creating disk temporary tables
condition: Statements with disk temporary tables exist.

title: Top 10 statements with full table scans
condition: Statements that executed with no index exist.

title: Top 10 statements by execution count
condition: Always emitted when digests are available.

title: Status snapshot
condition: Always emitted.

title: Schema sizes
condition: Always emitted.

title: Largest 20 tables
condition: Always emitted.

title: Growth since last snapshot
condition: A previous snapshot exists to compare against.

title: Server identity
condition: Always emitted.
reads: version and fork facts from 01_session.sql plus the universal settings

title: Host resources
condition: Always emitted when host resources are supplied.

title: Plugins and components
condition: Always emitted.

title: Replication topology
condition: Always emitted.
reads: the normalised replica status from 01_session.sql §6c, @dbt_binlog_dump_threads, semi-sync status, GTID variables

title: Connection summary
condition: Always emitted.

title: InnoDB summary
condition: Always emitted.
reads: InnoDB settings (universal ones inline, fork-specific ones from the bundle), information_schema.TABLES for data size by engine

title: Object counts
condition: Always emitted.
reads: information_schema TABLES, VIEWS, ROUTINES, TRIGGERS, EVENTS, PARTITIONS, STATISTICS, TABLE_CONSTRAINTS

title: Accounts summary
condition: Always emitted.

title: Statistics window
condition: Always emitted.
